events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album,' on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. Still a masterclass in musical diversity, from 'Back in the U.S.S.R.' to 'Helter Skelter'.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the 35th anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true legend. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul,' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: 59 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. Widely seen as a pivotal album, what's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: It's 46 years since the world lost music icon John Lennon, who was tragically killed in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years on. His music and message continue to inspire generations around the globe.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, born in 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. Celebrating the incredible legacy of David Bowie, a true innovator who constantly reinvented himself.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born in 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. There's only one King!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page, born in 1944, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! The Led Zeppelin legend, responsible for some of rock's most iconic riffs.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the legendary Rod Stewart! From Faces to solo superstardom, a true showman.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Main Man
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the one and only frontman of Madness! Still bringing the house down after all these years.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that incredible voice that gave us so many 80s classics.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, born in 1946, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Celebrating Dolly
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the one and only Dolly Parton. A true icon of music, philanthropy, and pure joy.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow, born in 1971, celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Gary's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That chart-toppers to solo success, he's still got it.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, famous for his 70s and 80s R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! Still got us dancing with those timeless tracks.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame First Induction
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the first-ever Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony, held in 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years since the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who do you think was the most deserving of that initial class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen, born in 1972, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Mark's Milestone
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From boyband heartthrob to solo artist, a true survivor of pop.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert Anniversary
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of The Beatles' famous impromptu rooftop concert on Savile Row in London, which took place in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles played their iconic final live performance on a London rooftop. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, born in 1951, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Phil's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A drumming powerhouse and a voice behind countless hits.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, born in 1960, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Hugh's Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the charming Hugh Grant! From rom-coms to RADA, a true British institution.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake, born in 1981, celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: JT's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to solo superstardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: National treasure Sir David Jason, the iconic British actor, born in 1940, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true icon of British television. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died Anniversary
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper, whose music still resonates today.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: English singer-songwriter Rick Astley, famous for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', born in 1966, celebrates his 61st birthday today.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Him Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to Rick Astley! Still 'Never Gonna Give You Up' on those classic 80s tunes.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Reggae legend Bob Marley, born in 1945, would have celebrated his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: On what would have been his 82nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring spirit and music of Bob Marley. One love, one heart.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Prolific American singer-songwriter Carole King, born in 1942, celebrates her 85th birthday today.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King! A songwriting legend whose 'Tapestry' of work continues to inspire.

events.title: Remembering Whitney Houston
events.blurb: It's the 15th anniversary of the passing of the incomparable Whitney Houston, who died in 2012.

angles.name: Voice of a Generation
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Whitney Houston today, 15 years since we lost that phenomenal voice. Her music lives on.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary
events.blurb: It's 31 years since Take That broke the hearts of millions by announcing their split in 1996.

angles.name: That Day In 96
angles.copy: Remember that day in '96 when Take That announced their split? A moment that stopped the nation. Thankfully, they're back!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Ali Campbell, lead singer of the iconic reggae band UB40, born in 1959, celebrates his 68th birthday today.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell of UB40! Still bringing those reggae vibes and sunshine to our airwaves.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran, born in 1991, celebrates his 36th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From busking to stadium tours, what an incredible journey.
